entries.en: I'd hoped the Alliance would take this meeting seriously.
Instead, they insult me by sending a military grunt to show me how tough they are.
I had the strongest syndicate in the area. They gave me the weapons and money I needed to take over.
So do not pretend we are so different, soldier. I deserve your Alliance's gratitude, not these attacks!
You think you can take me down! I've killed worse than you!
If you're prepared to treat me as a powerful and respected ally of the Alliance, certainly.
Now, I assume you were going to apologize on behalf of the Alliance for trespassing and theft.
Now, to discuss the considerations you will be providing.
If you agree to these terms, then only one thing remains for us to reach an agreement.
You can't talk that way to me! The Alliance will learn to respect me when I send them your bloody corpse!
Instead, they send me a woman. Were you supposed to use your assets to win concessions from me?
Your file says you were a war hero during the Blitz. They must give medals to anyone these days.
Your file says you couldn't even save the rest of your unit on Akuze. You got everyone killed.
According to your file, your only mark of distinction is that you stupidly got your own soldiers killed on Torfan.
Actually, given my rank, I'd prefer that you call me "Lord Darius". Or, "your lordship", if my name is too difficult for you.
These are not simply criminal raids! This was a legal military action to address Alliance trespasses!
Alliance miners were illegally extracting element zero from an asteroid in my territory!
Punitive attacks were the only appropriate response, and I demand an apology from the Alliance!
I'm pleased that the Alliance is willing to admit its responsibility for this situation.
Now that clear boundaries have been established, I believe we can find a solution that benefits both sides.
The miners are welcome to mine element zero on my asteroid, in exchange for certain considerations.
The miners will pay a reasonable fee for the right to extract and export element zero from my territory.
In addition, they will give us a monthly quantity of element zero, as well as refining equipment to produce red sand.
Excellent. Then there is only one other factor between us and an agreement.
I want you to ask me nicely. It's the least the Alliance can do after I took their offer and helped them stabilize this region.
Swallow your military bravado, Commander Shepard. And say please.
Excellent. After everything I've done for the Alliance, I'm glad that I'm being accorded the respect I deserve.
This OSD formalizes everything. I'm certain our new agreement will be to everyone's advantage.
Thank you for your cooperation, Commander. It's been a pleasure meeting you.
You can't speak to me that way! You and your Alliance owe me, Shepard!
You see this gun? This is your gun. Your military set me up here! Now it wants to pretend it doesn't know me!
But I know the truth! The Alliance needed me here! So treat me with the respect I deserve!
After the batarians were driven out of the Verge, the Alliance wanted to stabilize the region.
You said we set you up. Did the Alliance give you weapons?
You want the respect you deserve, you piece of crap? Here you go.
Someone once said that diplomacy comes from the barrel of a gun.
I apologize. Now, let's get back to business.
I'm not here to put up with your crap, Darius. Shall we talk, or should I just shoot you now?
I don't believe my background is relevant here, Mr. Darius. Shall we talk?
Is that a bad joke? I've killed worse than you on my way to real problems.
Of course... Lord Darius. Now, what will it take for these raids to stop?
It was never your territory! You're killing innocent people, and it's going to stop. Now.
The Alliance offers its apologies. We did not realize that you'd claimed that asteroid.
You kill innocent civilians, and now you want us to pay you? You've gone too far!
We're willing to discuss that. What kind of considerations did you have in mind?
You want us to pay you and help you make drugs? You're deluded, Lord Darius.
I believe we can manage that.
Stop the raids, get off the asteroid, and I won't waste a bullet on you. Please.
Please, Lord Darius. I'm asking you to work with us as a friend of the Alliance.
Bad choice of words.
Bad choice of words.
Bad choice of words.
Go to hell.
Enough pleasantries.
Not likely.
You're a petty thug.
Fine.
That's garbage!
I don't think so.
I'm sorry.
That's enough.
You're out of your mind!
I'm listening.
You're full of it.
No, they will not.
Agreed.
You want nice? Try this!
I've had enough.
I would appreciate it.
What do you mean?
You deserve nothing.
I've had enough.
You're right.
I'm sure you can show yourself out. I look forward to hearing from your superiors to finalize the details of our arrangement.
